Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.query

Interface QueryCursor<T>

Type Parameters:
T - the type of the elements
All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable, Iterable<T>
public interface QueryCursor<T> extends Iterable<T>, AutoCloseable
Streams the results of one read, one at a time, while its statement stays open.

A cursor is read once: iterator() and stream() share one single use, so a second call to either, or a stream taken after the iterator, is refused. Reading the last element closes the cursor, so a loop that runs to the end releases everything by itself; a loop left early must call close(), best through try-with-resources. map(Function) gives a view over the same rows that shares the single use and the close. 


 try (QueryCursor<Map<String, Object>> rows = db.table("orders").orderBy("id").cursor()) {
     for (Map<String, Object> row : rows) {
         export(row);
     }
 }

A cursor is not thread-safe and belongs to the thread that opened it.

Not for implementation outside Diwan: methods added later arrive as default methods.

    • stream

      Stream<T> stream()
      Returns the elements as a lazy stream, once.

      Closing the stream closes the cursor. A stream that is neither read to the end nor closed keeps its connection, so use it in try-with-resources: a bare stream().forEach(...) that stops early leaves the cursor open.

      Returns:
      the stream, never null
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the cursor, or a view of it, was already iterated or streamed

    • map

      <R> QueryCursor<R> map(Function<? super T,? extends R> mapper)
      Returns a view of this cursor that maps every element.

      The view reads the same rows: it shares the single use and the close with this cursor, so closing either closes both. The mapper runs as each element is read; when it throws, the cursor is closed and the exception is rethrown.

      Type Parameters:
      R - the type of the mapped elements
      Parameters:
      mapper - the mapping, never null
      Returns:
      the mapped view, never null
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if mapper is null
